messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — p95 latency SLO breach detected for route /v1/generate in eu-west-1. p95 = 740ms over last 2m, SLO=250ms. Smart-routing policy 'latency-auto-swap' triggered 3 reroutes in last 90s. Paging ops_oncall_jay.

ops_oncall_jay: on it. grabbing context from console. any errors in logs?

nina: I see alternating routing decisions between eu-west-1 -> eu-central-1 and a fallback to 'redwood-7b-quant' variant in eu-west-1. The quantized variant is 30-40% slower at these seq lengths (~300 tokens) due to kernel mismatch. That explains the oscillation — fallback increases latency which triggers another reroute.

kevin: confirmed. model variant mismatch: fallback was meant to be redwood-7b-emb-fast but policy referenced redwood-7b-quant. looks like a config drift after last rollout.

ops_oncall_jay: initial mitigation plan: 1) disable 'latency-auto-swap' policy 2) pin route to redwood-7b-v1 in eu-west-1 3) scale up pool by 2 GPUs to absorb load. trying step 1 now.

infra-bot: `runbook action` executed by ops_oncall_jay: PATCH /api/v1/policies/latency-auto-swap -> enabled=false (request id 0a9f).

ops_oncall_jay: disabled policy. monitor for churn.

maddy: putting quick pin to redwood-7b-v1 on eu-west route. command: ```
redwood route update --route /v1/generate --region eu-west-1 --model redwood-7b-v1 --pin true
```

kevin: done. pinned. Also found the rollout that introduced the quant variant — PR #2147 changed fallback mapping. I've reverted fallback mapping in staging; will push a hotfix for production if needed.

lia: heads-up to support: starting incident message to enterprise customers in eu region. low-level impact for chat/assistant integrations — increased response latency, some timeouts observed. adding note to status page.

alex: product: estimate customer-visible errors? any retries/exceeded timeouts count?

nina: preliminary: ~2.3% increase in 5xxs for eu tenants in last 10m, majority are upstream timeouts at 30s. Token throughput remained within normal.

ops_oncall_jay: scaling pool +2gpus now. infra-bot reports capacity change starting...

infra-bot: autoscale: launched 2 x g5.2xlarge instances into gpu-pool-eu-west (id pool-54ef). expected ready in ~90s.

ops_oncall_jay: after disabling policy + pin + scale: p95 dropped to 260ms, still above SLO but stable. no more reroutes observed.

kevin: pushing hotfix to remove the wrong mapping and add test coverage for fallback mappings. will also add a guard so policy won't select quantized variant unless kernel support flag is true. starting deploy.

maddy: oncall handoff: ops_oncall_jay -> nina for next 60m. nina you're primary for monitoring and customer updates.

nina: acknowledged. will watch for 30m then escalate if p95 > 300ms.

lia: support update posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/RED-2026-184. Sending proactive emails to top 10 enterprise accounts in region.

alex: ok to disable smart-routing policy globally? feels risky. prefer a targeted rollback + guard.

ops_oncall_jay: agree. we disabled it for eu-west-1 only. not global.

kevin: hotfix merged to canary. will promote to prod with slow rollout. Notes in PR: revert mapping, add unit tests, add policy guard.

nina: quick note on post-incident: request postmortem with timeline and root cause (misconfigured fallback mapping after PR) and remediation (test + policy guard + playbook update). assigning to eng-runtime + ops.

maddy: I'll create incident tracking ticket and assign owners. ticket: INC-3821.

ops_oncall_jay: final status: mitigated at 1767894700 — p95 stabilized ~220ms after actions. Impact: elevated latency and ~2.3% 5xx for 12m. No data exfiltration. Next steps: kevin to deploy fix, nina + maddy to own postmortem, lia to coordinate customer comms. handing off to oncall shift lead for follow-up.

nina: oncall handover note: observed residual latency on long sequences (>500 tokens); recommend follow-up eval with synthetic prompts to see kernel perf cliffs.

kevin: logged follow-up perf task and scheduling kernel bench for quantized variants.

lia: sending customer follow-ups now.

maddy: closing incident thread for active paging. will keep ticket open until postmortem done. :white_check_mark:
